threat_event: Stolen technician session sends a malicious script through the RMM to many clients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One tenant for all clients; one approver for multi-client scripts; push MFA in the legacy tenant
likelihood_basis: EV-061 (one tenant; one approver for multi-client scripts); EV-060 (push MFA in the legacy tenant); EV-089 (RMM threats described)
existing_controls: Named accounts; script library in version control
treatment_plan: Two-person approval; per-client script scopes; SIEM alerts on multi-client jobs (POAM-013, POAM-015)

threat_event: Technician and partner-operator identities are phished through the legacy identity tenant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA; 12-hour sessions; legacy tenant outside SYS-G1 governance
likelihood_basis: EV-060 (push MFA; 12-hour sessions; outside SYS-G1 governance); EV-047 (partner-operator role federated from the legacy tenant)
treatment_plan: Migrate all Managed IT identities to SYS-G1 with hardware keys by 2027-03-31; partner operators first (POAM-001, POAM-023)
owner: Managed IT division security and compliance lead

threat_event: RMM agents bring the RMM into PCI DSS and CMMC scope
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents on settlement-support servers and enclave management servers
likelihood_basis: EV-061 (agents on 140 settlement-support servers and enclave management servers); EV-063 (enclave inventory does not list the RMM)

threat_event: CMMC Level 2 (C3PAO) is not achieved before 2027 DoD option exercises if primes still require it (CMMC Phase 2 is suspended)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 of 110 requirements not fully met; no C3PAO engaged
likelihood_basis: EV-063 (96 of 110 requirements fully met; no C3PAO); EV-064 (primes expect Level 2 at 2027 option periods)
treatment_plan: Close gaps; voluntary C3PAO engagement by 2027-01-31 (POAM-021)
owner: Managed IT federal contracts compliance officer

threat_event: The SPRS assessment expires (2027-02-12) and the division becomes ineligible for award
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Basic self-assessment dated 2024-02-12; DFARS 252.204-7019 requires one not more than 3 years old
likelihood_basis: EV-063 (SPRS self-assessment dated 2024-02-12); EV-089 (SPRS date described)
treatment_plan: New assessment and SPRS posting by 2027-01-15 (POAM-021)
owner: Managed IT federal contracts compliance officer

threat_event: DIB clients fail their own CMMC assessments because the division's ESP duties are not documented
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No ESP responsibility matrix; services in clients' assessment scope as Security Protection Assets or CUI assets
likelihood_basis: EV-058 (no ESP responsibility matrix for about 150 DIB clients)
treatment_plan: ESP responsibility matrix and evidence package for clients (POAM-022)
owner: Managed IT federal contracts compliance officer

threat_event: A DFARS 72-hour report for an enclave incident is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Medium assurance certificate held by one person; enclave not in the group matrix
likelihood_basis: EV-064 (one certificate holder; no prime notice step; procedure not tested); EV-016 (enclave not in a group matrix)
treatment_plan: Second certificate holder; matrix row; prime notice step (POAM-004)
owner: Managed IT federal contracts compliance officer

threat_event: An RMM incident cannot be scoped because logs are kept 90 days and not in the SIEM
likelihood_basis: EV-061 (RMM logs kept 90 days; not forwarded to the SIEM); EV-012 (RMM not a SIEM source)
owner: Managed IT division security and compliance lead

threat_event: A breach notice to health care clients under BAAs is late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BAA terms vary; no notice register
likelihood_basis: EV-058 (BAA terms from 10 to 60 days; no notice register)
treatment_plan: BAA notice register in the P08 matrix

threat_event: Bank clients are not notified as soon as possible after a 4-hour material disruption
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Designated contacts on file for 121 of about 190 banks (64%)
likelihood_basis: EV-059 (designated contacts for 121 of about 190 banks)

threat_event: Staff follow the 2024 division standards where they conflict with 2026 group policy
owner: Managed IT division security and compliance lead

threat_event: Assessors and clients cannot see which controls the division inherits
likelihood_basis: EV-019 (no inheritance record for Managed IT)
owner: Managed IT division security and compliance lead

threat_event: The AI runbook automation agent runs a wrong remediation on client servers
threat_source: Model error or prompt injection through ticket text
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agent can execute 12 approved runbooks without a human
likelihood_basis: EV-068 (12 approved runbooks run without a human since 2026-03); EV-089 (runbook agent described)
existing_controls: Runbooks limited to restarts and disk cleanup
treatment_plan: Human approval for all executions until evaluation passes (P10)

threat_event: The RMM vendor's platform is compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SaaS RMM with agent-level code execution
likelihood_basis: EV-028 (RMM vendor SOC 2 report; no incident notice clock); EV-061 (agent-level code execution on about 380,000 systems)
treatment_plan: Contract incident notice within 24 hours; agent kill switch drill

threat_event: Federal contract information sits in the general consulting workspace
likelihood_basis: EV-065 (FCI in the general consulting workspace)
owner: Managed IT federal contracts compliance officer

threat_event: Client credentials are stored in RMM and ticket documentation fields
likelihood_basis: EV-089 (engineers paste client credentials into notes); EV-066 (access broker holds credentials for most clients)
existing_controls: Client privileged access broker for most clients
treatment_plan: Secret scanning of notes; move credentials to the access broker

threat_event: A covered person at a follow-the-sun support vendor accesses bulk sensitive data
likelihood_basis: EV-027 (no covered-person screening of support vendors)

threat_event: A consultant laptop with client data is lost
likelihood_basis: EV-010 (encryption, EDR and remote wipe on laptops)
treatment_plan: Accepted: encrypted devices make disclosure unlikely
owner: Managed IT division security and compliance lead
